cards.name: Ambassador Oak
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.

cards.name: Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop
cards.oracleText:
When Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop enters, you get {TK}{TK}{TK}, then you may put a sticker on a nonland permanent you own.
At the beginning of each combat, you may have Ambassador Blorpityblorpboop's base power become equal to the total power of all stickers on permanents you control and its base toughness become equal to those stickers' total toughness.

cards.name: Ambassador of Evendo
cards.oracleText: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, a random land card in your library perpetually gains "Whenever this land becomes tapped, draw a card."
